items.exampleEn: The tent needs four metal poles.
items.exampleZh: 這頂帳篷需要四根金屬桿子。

items.exampleEn: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
items.exampleZh: 這座公園保護許多種野生動物。

items.exampleEn: The lion walked up and down in its cage.
items.exampleZh: 獅子在籠子裡走來走去。

items.exampleEn: Bananas grow well in tropical countries.
items.exampleZh: 香蕉在熱帶國家長得很好。

items.exampleEn: A whale is not a fish.
Mosquitoes lay their eggs in still water.
items.exampleZh: 蚊子在靜止的水裡產卵。

items.exampleEn: Heavy rainfall closed several roads yesterday.
items.exampleZh: 昨天的大量降雨讓好幾條路封閉。

items.sentenceEn: Many tropical birds have bright colors.
items.sentenceZh: 很多熱帶鳥類有鮮豔的顏色。

items.audioEn: Bring something for the mosquitoes tonight, because we're camping by the lake.
items.audioZh: 今晚帶點防蚊的東西，因為我們要在湖邊露營。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今晚要帶防蚊的東西？
options: It will rain all night long.

items.sentenceEn: Keep the window closed to stop mosquitoes.
items.sentenceZh: 把窗戶關著來擋住蚊子。

items.sentenceEn: The rabbit's cage needs cleaning every week.
items.sentenceZh: 兔子的籠子每週都需要清理。

items.stemEn: Monkeys, snakes, and many birds are part of the local ____.
items.stemZh: 猴子、蛇和許多鳥類都是當地野生動物的一部分。

items.stemEn: This area gets very little ____, so farmers bring water from the river.
items.stemZh: 這個地區降雨很少，所以農夫從河裡引水。

items.passageEn: Last summer, I joined a researcher on a trip to a tropical island. The island gets a lot of rainfall, so everything is green. We watched whales from a boat and studied the wildlife in the forest. The mosquitoes were terrible at night! We also found rocks full of minerals near an old flag pole. In a small zoo on the island, I was sad to see a bird in a tiny cage. The researcher said wild animals should live free.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我跟著一位研究人員去一座熱帶島嶼。島上降雨量很多，所以到處都是綠色的。我們從船上看鯨魚，也研究森林裡的野生動物。晚上的蚊子多得可怕！我們還在一根舊旗桿附近發現了富含礦物的石頭。在島上的一座小動物園裡，我難過地看到一隻鳥被關在小小的籠子裡。研究人員說野生動物應該自由地生活。

questions.questionZh: 在動物園裡，什麼讓作者難過？
options: 一隻被關在小籠子裡的鳥

questions.questionZh: 為什麼島上到處都是綠色的？
options: 因為島上的降雨量很多

referenceEn: There are many minerals in this mountain.
rubricZh: mineral 表示「礦物、礦物質」，可數名詞，例如 rich in minerals 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 wildlife 造一個句子，說說你看過或想看的野生動物。
referenceEn: I saw a lot of wildlife on my trip to the mountains.
I want to see wildlife in the jungle one day.
rubricZh: wildlife 表示「野生動物」，是不可數名詞，例如 see wildlife 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
